observations.meaning: The structural screen is computed on the candidate-generation consensus geometry, not on external validation or a stability score.
observations.finding: Partition-level structural diagnostics are triage evidence derived from the same consensus geometry used to construct the candidate partition.

observations.meaning: Every candidate set screens at the single-cluster resolution, meaning the dominant spectral gap is at k=1.
observations.finding: No candidate set shows a dominant multi-cluster subdivision signal in this screening calculation; this is absence of a subdivision signal, not evidence about independence from neighboring candidates.

observations.meaning: Magnitude of the leading spectral gap at the single-cluster resolution for each candidate set.
observations.finding: Leading gaps are large across sets (range 0.633 to 0.964), describing dominance of the single-cluster resolution rather than internal multi-cluster substructure.

observations.meaning: Full spectral gap profile across candidate resolutions for each set.
observations.finding: Secondary gaps are substantially smaller than the leading gap in every set, so the profiles consistently locate the dominant gap at k=1; K8_C0005 has the largest secondary gap (0.256) but still well below its leading gap.

observations.meaning: Average candidate-generation consensus affinity among patients within each candidate set.
observations.finding: Within-set affinity is highest for K8_C0007 (0.685) and K8_C0001 (0.635) and lowest for K8_C0005 (0.380), indicating heterogeneous internal cohesion across the partition.

observations.meaning: Relatively close candidate pairs and their between-set affinity, serving as a pair-review entry point rather than a merge conclusion.
observations.finding: The closest boundaries are K8_C0004-K8_C0006 (0.194), K8_C0006-K8_C0008 (0.178), and K8_C0002-K8_C0003 (0.173); these between-set affinities remain below the corresponding within-set affinities, so they identify boundaries for possible pair review without establishing merge.

observations.meaning: Number of patients represented in each structural calculation.
observations.finding: Set sizes range from 7 to 20 patients, so structural estimates rest on modest and unequal sample coverage across the partition.

reports.dimension_interpretation: This partition-level structural screen evaluates whether current membership or boundaries are represented in the candidate-generation consensus geometry and whether any candidate shows a decision-relevant internal subdivision. All eight sets screen at candidate_k=1 with large leading eigengaps (0.633-0.964) and much smaller secondary gaps, so the dominant spectral resolution is the single-cluster one; this describes dominance of the single-cluster resolution and does not constitute evidence of internal multi-cluster substructure. Within-set affinity is heterogeneous (0.380-0.685), and the nearest-pair affinities (0.066-0.194) identify relatively close boundaries, notably K8_C0004-K8_C0006, K8_C0006-K8_C0008, and K8_C0002-K8_C0003, while remaining below their respective within-set affinities. Overall the partition-level structural pattern is coherent for the single-cluster resolution and provides a pair-review entry point, but it is triage evidence only and does not establish retention, split, or merge.
reports.cross_evidence_context: No prior reports or additional modality-specific native-geometry results are available in this round; the structural screen is the sole evidence source and is computed on the candidate-generation consensus geometry rather than external validation.
limitations: Structural diagnostics are partition-level triage evidence and do not by themselves establish biological meaning or clinical validity.

reports.dimension_interpretation: K8_C0001 shows a coherent, predominantly down-regulated transcriptomic phenotype relative to the rest of the partition, dominated by oxidative phosphorylation and related metabolic programs (adipogenesis, fatty acid metabolism, xenobiotic, heme, bile acid) with FDR q at or below 0.045. Up-regulated programs (pancreas beta cells, EMT, MYC targets, E2F targets, angiogenesis) do not reach adjusted significance (q 0.127-0.223). This characterizes a coherent biological identity for the candidate but does not by itself establish that its current membership or granularity deserves independent retention.
reports.cross_evidence_context: The partition-level structural screen reported candidate_k=1 with large leading eigengaps for all sets, and the confounder screen reported partition-wide technical associations (e.g., ct_phase PERMANOVA q=0.0025, ct_slice_thickness q=0.002, ct_z_spacing q=0.002, tissue_source_site q=0.0025). These are partition-scope observations and do not alter the set-scope biological interpretation for K8_C0001.

reports.dimension_interpretation: At partition scope, multiple measured technical, acquisition, and site factors show significant associations with the partition geometry: CT phase (q=0.0025, R2=0.154), CT manufacturer (q=0.0067, R2=0.059), CT slice thickness (q=0.002, R2=0.136), CT z spacing (q=0.002, R2=0.142), CT pixel spacing (q=0.035, R2=0.019), study year (q=0.004, R2=0.029), and tissue source site (q=0.0025, R2=0.191). CT reconstruction kernel (q=0.054) and scanner model (q=0.054) are not significant after BH adjustment. PERMDISP indicates significant dispersion differences for CT phase, manufacturer, and tissue source site, so those PERMANOVA results may reflect both location and dispersion. These are partition-wide associations and do not establish causation or technical artifact, and they must not be presented as candidate-specific confounder associations.
reports.cross_evidence_context: The partition-level structural screen reported candidate_k=1 with large leading eigengaps for all sets, and the set-scope RNA enrichment reports coherent biological phenotypes for each candidate. reports.dimension_interpretation: At partition scope, multiple measured technical, acquisition, and site factors show significant associations with the partition geometry: CT phase (q=0.0025, R2=0.154), CT manufacturer (q=0.0067, R2=0.059), CT slice thickness (q=0.002, R2=0.136), CT z spacing (q=0.002, R2=0.142), CT pixel spacing (q=0.035, R2=0.019), study year (q=0.004, R2=0.029), and tissue source site (q=0.0025, R2=0.191). CT reconstruction kernel (q=0.054) and scanner model (q=0.054) are not significant after BH adjustment. PERMDISP indicates significant dispersion differences for CT phase, manufacturer, and tissue source site, so those PERMANOVA results may reflect both location and dispersion. These are partition-wide associations and do not establish causation or technical artifact, and they must not be presented as candidate-specific confounder associations.
reports.cross_evidence_context: The partition-level structural screen reported candidate_k=1 with large leading eigengaps for all sets, and the set-scope RNA enrichment reports coherent biological phenotypes for each candidate. The confounder associations here are partition-scope and do not directly inform candidate-specific alternative explanations; they indicate a partition-wide technical concern that should be weighed alongside, not instead of, the biological and structural evidence.
limitations: Partition-scope associations describe a partition-wide technical concern and must not be presented as candidate-specific confounder associations.
A significant PERMANOVA does not establish technical artifact or causation; a nonsignificant PERMDISP does not establish absence of confounding.
PERMANOVA, PERMDISP, and continuous distance-regression p-values belong to separate BH families and are not directly comparable.
Factor R-squared values are univariable and must not be added to estimate independent variance explained.
PERMDISP was not estimable for CT reconstruction kernel and scanner model due to sparse levels.
Sample coverage is modest (n=103) with imbalanced factor levels (e.g., CT manufacturer GE 70, Philips 3, Siemens 30; CT phase UNKNOWN 40).

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: This partition-level structural screen evaluates whether current membership or boundaries are represented in the candidate-generation consensus geometry and whether any candidate shows a decision-relevant internal subdivision. All eight sets screen at candidate_k=1 with large leading eigengaps (0.633-0.964) and much smaller secondary gaps, so the dominant spectral resolution is the single-cluster one; this describes dominance of the single-cluster resolution and does not constitute evidence of internal multi-cluster substructure. Within-set affinity is heterogeneous (0.380-0.685), and the nearest-pair affinities (0.066-0.194) identify relatively close boundaries, notably K8_C0004-K8_C0006, K8_C0006-K8_C0008, and K8_C0002-K8_C0003, while remaining below their respective within-set affinities. Overall the partition-level structural pattern is coherent for the single-cluster resolution and provides a pair-review entry point, but it is triage evidence only and does not establish retention, split, or merge.
limitations: Structural diagnostics are partition-level triage evidence and do not by themselves establish biological meaning or clinical validity.
The geometry basis is candidate-generation consensus, not external validation or a stability score.
candidate_k=1 indicates absence of a dominant multi-cluster subdivision signal in this screen; it is not evidence about independence from neighboring candidates.
Nearest-pair affinities are a pair-review entry point, not a merge conclusion.
Sample coverage is modest and unequal (member_n 7-20), limiting precision of the structural estimates.
No native-modality (CT, WSI, RNA, WXS) patient-geometry results are available to jointly synthesize membership or boundary representation.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: K8_C0001 shows a coherent, predominantly down-regulated transcriptomic phenotype relative to the rest of the partition, dominated by oxidative phosphorylation and related metabolic programs (adipogenesis, fatty acid metabolism, xenobiotic, heme, bile acid) with FDR q at or below 0.045. Up-regulated programs (pancreas beta cells, EMT, MYC targets, E2F targets, angiogenesis) do not reach adjusted significance (q 0.127-0.223). This characterizes a coherent biological identity for the candidate but does not by itself establish that its current membership or granularity deserves independent retention.
limitations: Set-versus-rest contrast with 8 sets: the rest combines multiple heterogeneous candidate sets.
Modest set sample size (set_n=13) limits stability of enrichment estimates.
GSEA FDR q reflects multiplicity-adjusted enrichment evidence, not biological importance.
Ranking uses the unshrunken DESeq2 Wald statistic, not adjusted p-values or shrunken fold changes.
Biological identity does not by itself establish that current membership, boundary, or granularity deserves independent retention.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: At partition scope, multiple measured technical, acquisition, and site factors show significant associations with the partition geometry: CT phase (q=0.0025, R2=0.154), CT manufacturer (q=0.0067, R2=0.059), CT slice thickness (q=0.002, R2=0.136), CT z spacing (q=0.002, R2=0.142), CT pixel spacing (q=0.035, R2=0.019), study year (q=0.004, R2=0.029), and tissue source site (q=0.0025, R2=0.191). CT reconstruction kernel (q=0.054) and scanner model (q=0.054) are not significant after BH adjustment. PERMDISP indicates significant dispersion differences for CT phase, manufacturer, and tissue source site, so those PERMANOVA results may reflect both location and dispersion. These are partition-wide associations and do not establish causation or technical artifact, and they must not be presented as candidate-specific confounder associations.
limitations: Partition-scope associations describe a partition-wide technical concern and must not be presented as candidate-specific confounder associations.
A significant PERMANOVA does not establish technical artifact or causation; a nonsignificant PERMDISP does not establish absence of confounding.
PERMANOVA, PERMDISP, and continuous distance-regression p-values belong to separate BH families and are not directly comparable.
Factor R-squared values are univariable and must not be added to estimate independent variance explained.
PERMDISP was not estimable for CT reconstruction kernel and scanner model due to sparse levels.
Sample coverage is modest (n=103) with imbalanced factor levels (e.g., CT manufacturer GE 70, Philips 3, Siemens 30; CT phase UNKNOWN 40).

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: This partition-level structural screen evaluates whether current membership or boundaries are represented in the candidate-generation consensus geometry and whether any candidate shows an obvious internal subdivision signal. All seven sets screen at candidate_k=1, meaning the dominant spectral gap sits at the single-cluster resolution; this describes single-cluster dominance and does not constitute evidence of internal multi-cluster substructure. limitations: Partition structural diagnostics are triage evidence only and do not independently establish retention, split, or merge.
The geometry basis is candidate-generation consensus, not external validation or a stability score.
Absence of a dominant multi-cluster subdivision signal is neither positive nor negative evidence about independence from neighboring candidates.
No feasible k>=2 internal split solutions were produced, so set-level subdivision cannot be interpreted from this screen.
No CT, WSI, RNA, or WXS native patient-geometry results are present in this round, so cross-modal agreement or disagreement cannot be assessed.
Between-set affinities are relative pair-review indicators and are not threshold-based merge rules.

plan.rationale: Router authorized merge of K8_C0002 and K8_C0003. Structural diagnostics show high normalized-cut cost (0.634) with substantial cross-boundary connectivity and a union eigengap dominated at k=1 (0.530), the single-cluster resolution, making the boundary weak and merge-compatible. Native-view boundary representation is only weak and directionally consistent (silhouettes 0.047-0.120), not affirmative. Coherent but distinct RNA identities do not prohibit merge. Revision is provisional and returns to normal review.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: This partition-level structural screen evaluates whether current membership or boundaries are represented in the candidate-generation consensus geometry and whether any candidate shows an obvious internal subdivision signal. All seven sets screen at candidate_k=1, meaning the dominant spectral gap sits at the single-cluster resolution; this describes single-cluster dominance and does not constitute evidence of internal multi-cluster substructure. Within-set affinity varies substantially (0.282-0.685), with K8_C0002_M_K8_C0003 notably lower than the others. Nearest-pair between-set affinities are uniformly lower than within-set affinities, with the closest boundaries involving K8_C0004, K8_C0006, and K8_C0008. Overall, the native-view structural pattern is coherent at the partition level for single-cluster representation, but it provides no positive internal-subdivision signal and only triage-level boundary information; it does not establish biological meaning or clinical validity.
limitations: Partition structural diagnostics are triage evidence only and do not independently establish retention, split, or merge.
The geometry basis is candidate-generation consensus, not external validation or a stability score.
Absence of a dominant multi-cluster subdivision signal is neither positive nor negative evidence about independence from neighboring candidates.
No feasible k>=2 internal split solutions were produced, so set-level subdivision cannot be interpreted from this screen.
No CT, WSI, RNA, or WXS native patient-geometry results are present in this round, so cross-modal agreement or disagreement cannot be assessed.
Between-set affinities are relative pair-review indicators and are not threshold-based merge rules.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: K8_C0001 shows a coherent, interpretable transcriptomic phenotype relative to the rest of the partition, dominated by coordinated down-regulation of oxidative phosphorylation and related metabolic/lipid programs (OXPHOS NES -1.97, FDR q 0.001; adipogenesis, fatty-acid metabolism, protein secretion all down at FDR q < 0.01). The up-regulated programs are weak and non-significant after multiplicity adjustment (best up NES 1.24, FDR q 0.127). This is a directional, internally consistent metabolic-down identity rather than a diffuse or absent signal.
limitations: Set-versus-rest contrast uses a heterogeneous rest (90 samples across six other sets), so enrichment reflects difference from a mixed population.
Ranking uses the unshrunken DESeq2 Wald statistic, not shrunken fold changes or adjusted p-values.
FDR q values are multiple-testing-adjusted enrichment evidence, not biological importance.
Biological identity does not by itself establish that current membership, boundary, or granularity deserves independent retention.
